details: PATHFINDER. A narrow upright off-white and aubergine reconnaissance biped, with a tiny forward-canted cab offset towards its own right and an aqua pilot slit. Give the permanent protected survey instrument one clearly glazed, sideways-surveying wide solid head in an open-edged roll hoop: asymmetrical and unmistakably a receiver, with neither barrel nor black hole. The two compact guns are lower and separated from it: own-left small lens emitter and own-right light machine gun. Lanky open-link legs; splayed compact two-prong field shoes with a rear heel. Strong Negative space around protected optics. Contract the chassis around the survey head; avoid the horizontal Kestrel beak.
